Own-residual check, reading EO 12078 in full (secs. 1-101 to 1-402): it created an advisory commission, its membership, staff and expense provisions, and its reports; it transferred no function, fund or property to another body, revoked or amended no other order, and created no right (the Commission's powers were advisory; the FACA functions were performed by the GSA Administrator under EO 12024, which this order does not touch). The Commission ended on its own term (as amended by EO 12219) before EO 12258. S0 prefill (none_after_bounded_search) KEPT after reading both. research_rationale: EO 12078 (signed 1978-09-05, 43 FR 39741), read in full from the held FR text, establishes the Presidential Commission on World Hunger (sec. 1-1), sets its functions, administration and general provisions (secs. 1-2 to 1-4) and ends it by sec. 1-402 ('shall terminate on June 30, 1980, or earlier as directed by the President'). The machine own-term kinds are report deadlines (1-204, 1-206, 1-401) and a sunset_date (1-402). Reports are never ends. The sunset was moved by EO 12219 (45 FR 41897, held FR text, read in full), signed 1980-06-19 with no effective-date wording, which amended sec. 1-402 to 'The Commission shall terminate on August 31, 1980'; that amendment came before the original date, so the Commission's own term ended on 1980-08-31. No order after EO 12219 extended it: a by-number scan of all 6,652 held FR-original texts finds EO 12078 named only in EO 12219 and EO 12258 (the other hit is a page number).
